<!--
  READ ME (Quarto ignores HTML comments)

  1. Each quarter, update only the `params:` block above: quarter label, dates,
     download date, file paths, and the grantee-level inputs for Table 1
     (grants per round, grantees entering data, onboarding months, grantees not
     yet serving). Narrative numbers, table titles, chart subtitles, footnotes
     and data-source lines are all generated from these params and the data.
  2. dhcs-q3-reference-doc.docx must sit in the same folder as this .qmd. It
     supplies the DHCS cover, logo, landscape layout, fonts, heading styles and
     the custom paragraph styles used below (DHCS Table Title, DHCS Table Caption Below, DHCS Data Note,
     DHCS Why, DHCS Caution, DHCS Internal Note, ...).
  3. Two versions from one file:
       external (default): quarto render 2026-Q3-quarterly-report.qmd
       internal:           quarto render 2026-Q3-quarterly-report.qmd -P show_notes:true
     The internal version adds the "Why these charts" boxes, the analyst notes
     (data used / assumptions), a raw-value -> report-label crosswalk check
     (UNSUPPRESSED counts: internal only) and an analyst appendix with the
     detail tables from the Q2 report (SDQ, per-question NOMS stats, etc.).
  4. Small-cell suppression: counts from 1 to (threshold - 1) show as "*".
     A category whose All Rounds count is that small is suppressed across the
     whole row. With complementary_suppression: true, if a column has exactly
     one hidden cell, the next-smallest cell in that column is hidden too so
     the hidden value can't be recovered from the TOTAL. Charts treat
     suppressed cells as zero. Spot-check the first real render.
  5. Category labels (gender, orientation, insurance, housing, participant
     type, education, discharge reason) are mapped from raw eInsight values by
     pattern. Render the internal version once and check the crosswalk table
     in the appendix; adjust the *_rules vectors in the setup chunk if needed.
  6. Word asks to update fields when the file opens: say Yes to build the
     table of contents.
  7. Inclusion criteria (agreed Oct 2026):
       Enrollments   = records with an assigned intervention (no start-date
                       requirement, because of the upload feature). Counted
                       per service episode, NOT unduplicated.
       Discharges    = records with an intervention end date. Not unduplicated.
       Demographics  = clients with an assigned intervention, unduplicated
                       (one row per client_system_id).
     exclude_after_period_end: true also leaves out interventions that start
     (or, for discharges, end) after period_end, so a late download can't pull
     in next quarter's records. Records with no start date are always kept.
     dedupe_episodes: false counts every row, as the Q2 report did. The
     internal version prints a check table showing the counts under each rule.
-->

```{r}

# ---- text helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
fmt_n   <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","))
fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) ifelse(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x), "",
                                          paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%"))
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
# counts quoted in prose/footnotes: small counts are never printed exactly
n_phrase <- function(n, cap = FALSE) {
  out <- if (n > 0 && n < threshold) paste("fewer than", threshold) else fmt_n(n)
  if (cap) paste0(toupper(substr(out, 1, 1)), substr(out, 2, nchar(out))) else out
}
and_list <- function(x, conj = "and") {
  if (length(x) <= 1) return(x)
  if (length(x) == 2) return(paste(x, collapse = paste0(" ", conj, " ")))
  paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), ", ", conj, " ", x[length(x)])
}

# ---- recoding helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
as_round <- function(x) {
  num <- str_extract(as.character(x), "\\d+")
  factor(ifelse(is.na(num), NA_character_, paste("Round", as.integer(num))), levels = round_levels)
}

# "Don't Know", "Prefer Not to Answer", "Not Applicable", "No ... Selected", blank, NA
nonresponse_regex <- regex(paste0(
  "^\\s*(don.?t know|unknown|not applicable|n/?a|prefer not to (answer|respond|say)|",
  "declined?( to (answer|respond))?|no .*selected|none selected)\\s*$"), ignore_case = TRUE)
is_nonresponse <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  is.na(x) | str_trim(x) == "" | str_detect(x, nonresponse_regex)
}

# Map raw values to report labels: first matching pattern wins. Unmatched
# values keep their raw text (or `other`, if given) so nothing is silently lost.
recode_by_pattern <- function(x, rules, other = NULL) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(rules)) {
    hit <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x) & str_detect(x, regex(rules[[i]], ignore_case = TRUE))
    out[hit] <- names(rules)[i]
  }
  miss <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)
  out[miss] <- if (is.null(other)) x[miss] else other
  out
}

# ---- counting + suppression engine ------------------------------------------------
# Order categories by All Rounds frequency (or a fixed order); `last` goes at the end.
order_levels <- function(cats, n, order = c("freq", "fixed"), levels = NULL, last = NULL) {
  order <- match.arg(order)
  by_freq <- cats[order(-n, cats)]
  by_freq <- by_freq[n[match(by_freq, cats)] > 0]
  main <- if (order == "fixed") c(levels, setdiff(by_freq, c(levels, last))) else setdiff(by_freq, last)
  unique(c(main, last[last %in% c(levels, by_freq)]))
}

# d: one row per unit, with `category` and `round` columns.
count_long <- function(d, lv) {
  all_n <- d |> count(category, name = "n") |> mutate(group = "All Rounds")
  rnd_n <- d |> filter(!is.na(round)) |> mutate(group = as.character(round)) |> count(group, category, name = "n")
  bind_rows(all_n, rnd_n) |>
    mutate(category = as.character(category), n = as.integer(n)) |>
    filter(category %in% lv) |>
    complete(group = grp_levels, category = lv, fill = list(n = 0L)) |>
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = grp_levels), category = factor(category, levels = lv)) |>
    arrange(group, category) |>
    group_by(group) |> mutate(total = sum(n)) |> ungroup()
}

complement_one <- function(g) {
  hidden <- g$sup & g$n > 0
  if (sum(hidden) == 1) {
    cand <- which(!g$sup & g$n > 0)
    if (length(cand) > 0) g$sup[cand[which.min(g$n[cand])]] <- TRUE
  }
  g
}

# Adds row_sup (whole row hidden: All Rounds count is small), sup (cell hidden)
# and n_shown (0 where hidden; used by charts).
suppress_long <- function(long) {
  row_flag <- long |> filter(group == "All Rounds") |> transmute(category, row_sup = n > 0 & n < threshold)
  long <- long |>
    left_join(row_flag, by = "category") |>
    mutate(row_sup = coalesce(row_sup, FALSE),
           sup = row_sup | (n > 0 & n < threshold) | (total > 0 & total < threshold))
  if (isTRUE(params$complementary_suppression)) {
    long <- long |> group_by(group) |> group_modify(function(g, ...) complement_one(g)) |> ungroup()
  }
  long |> mutate(n_shown = if_else(sup, 0L, n))
}

# rows: all_data rows with a valid response and a `category` column.
make_demo <- function(rows, order = "freq", levels = NULL, last = NULL, small_rows = c("dash", "drop"),
                      denom = n_participants) {
  small_rows <- match.arg(small_rows)
  d <- rows |>
    distinct(client_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    mutate(round = as_round(funding_round))
  all_counts <- d |> count(category, name = "n")
  lv <- order_levels(all_counts$category, all_counts$n, order, levels, last)
  long <- count_long(d, lv) |> suppress_long()
  dropped <- long |> filter(group == "All Rounds", row_sup) |> pull(category) |> as.character()
  list(long = long, levels = lv, small_rows = small_rows, n_valid = nrow(d),
       n_missing = denom - nrow(d), pct_missing = 1 - nrow(d) / denom,
       dropped = if (small_rows == "drop") dropped else character(0))
}

# Wide display table: category | all_a | all_b | r1_a | r1_b | ... (a = %, b = N)
demo_wide <- function(res, groups = grp_levels) {
  dash <- "—"
  cells <- res$long |>
    filter(group %in% groups) |>
    mutate(a = case_when(row_sup | total == 0 ~ dash, sup ~ "*", TRUE ~ fmt_pct(n / total)),
           b = case_when(row_sup ~ dash, sup ~ "*", TRUE ~ fmt_n(n)))
  if (res$small_rows == "drop") cells <- cells |> filter(!row_sup)
  totals <- cells |>
    distinct(group, total) |>
    mutate(category = "TOTAL",
           a = case_when(total == 0 ~ dash, total < threshold ~ "*", TRUE ~ "100%"),
           b = case_when(total > 0 & total < threshold ~ "*", TRUE ~ fmt_n(total)))
  bind_rows(cells |> mutate(category = as.character(category)), totals) |>
    mutate(key = grp_key[as.character(group)]) |>
    select(category, key, a, b) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = c(a, b), names_glue = "{key}_{.value}") |>
    mutate(.ord = match(category, c(res$levels, "TOTAL"))) |>
    arrange(.ord) |> select(-.ord)
}

# Prose helpers (All Rounds values; hidden cells never quoted)
# Returns NA when the requested cells would reveal a hidden value. A sum that
# contains every hidden cell equals TOTAL minus shown cells, so it is safe.
share_of <- function(res, cats) {
  x <- res$long |> filter(group == "All Rounds")
  hidden <- x$sup & x$n > 0
  inside <- x$category %in% cats
  if (any(hidden & inside) && any(hidden & !inside)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(x$n[inside]) / x$total[1]
}
pct_of <- function(res, cats) {
  s <- share_of(res, cats)
  if (is.na(s)) "a suppressed share" else fmt_pct(s)
}
top_phrase <- function(res, k, exclude = NULL, lower = FALSE, conj = "and", skip = 0) {
  x <- res$long |>
    filter(group == "All Rounds", !sup, n > 0, !category %in% exclude) |>
    arrange(desc(n)) |> slice(seq_len(skip + k)) |> slice_tail(n = k)
  lab <- as.character(x$category)
  if (lower) lab <- str_to_lower(lab)
  and_list(paste0(lab, " (", fmt_pct(x$n / x$total), ")"), conj)
}
missing_note <- function(res, what) {
  paste0("Note: ", fmt_pct(res$pct_missing), " of participants responded Don't Know, Prefer Not to Answer, ",
         "Not Applicable, or No ", what, " Selected, or had no response recorded. ",
         "These responses are excluded from the data above.")
}

# Chart data: optionally collapse categories into chart groups; hidden cells = 0
chart_counts <- function(res, keep = NULL, other_label = NULL, groups = grp_levels) {
  x <- res$long |> filter(group %in% groups) |> mutate(category = as.character(category))
  if (!is.null(keep)) {
    x <- x |> mutate(category = if_else(category %in% keep, category, other_label))
    lv <- c(keep, other_label)
  } else {
    lv <- res$levels
  }
  # A chart group that holds every hidden cell in its column equals TOTAL minus
  # shown cells, so its true count is safe; otherwise hidden cells count as 0.
  x |>
    group_by(group) |> mutate(hid = sup & n > 0, n_hid = sum(hid)) |>
    group_by(group, category) |>
    summarise(n = if (any(hid) && sum(hid) < first(n_hid)) sum(n_shown) else sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(category = factor(category, levels = lv)) |>
    arrange(group, category)
}

# ---- DHCS table styling (matches the Q3 Word template) --------------------------------
dhcs_theme <- function(ft, font_size = 10) {
  b  <- fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.5)
  bw <- fp_border(color = "white", width = 0.5)
  ft |>
    font(fontname = "Segoe UI", part = "all") |>
    fontsize(size = font_size, part = "all") |>
    bg(bg = dhcs_blue, part = "header") |>
    color(color = "white", part = "header") |>
    bold(part = "header") |>
    border_remove() |>
    border_outer(border = b, part = "body") |>
    border_inner_h(border = b, part = "body") |>
    border_inner_v(border = b, part = "body") |>
    border_inner_v(border = bw, part = "header") |>
    border_inner_h(border = bw, part = "header") |>
    hline_top(border = b, part = "header") |>
    vline_left(border = b, part = "header") |>
    vline_right(border = b, part = "header") |>
    align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
    valign(valign = "center", part = "all") |>
    padding(padding.top = 2, padding.bottom = 2, padding.left = 4, padding.right = 4, part = "all") |>
    set_table_properties(layout = "fixed") |>
    keep_together()
}
# Keep a table on one page when it fits (Word "keep with next"); no-op on old flextable
keep_together <- function(ft) {
  if (flextable::nrow_part(ft, "body") > 25) return(ft)   # long tables may break across pages
  if (exists("paginate", where = asNamespace("flextable"), mode = "function")) {
    flextable::paginate(ft, init = TRUE, hdr_ftr = TRUE)
  } else ft
}

# Overall + by-round table with a two-row header (group over %/N)
dhcs_round_table <- function(wide, first_label, groups = grp_levels, sub = c("%", "N"),
                             show_grants = TRUE, first_width = NULL) {
  keys <- grp_key[groups]
  col_keys <- c("category", as.vector(rbind(paste0(keys, "_a"), paste0(keys, "_b"))))
  grant_n <- c(`All Rounds` = grants_total, grants)[groups]
  top <- if (show_grants) paste0(groups, "\n(", grant_n, " grants)") else groups
  ft <- flextable(wide, col_keys = col_keys) |>
    set_header_labels(values = setNames(as.list(c(first_label, rep(sub, length(groups)))), col_keys)) |>
    add_header_row(values = c(first_label, top), colwidths = c(1, rep(2, length(groups))), top = TRUE) |>
    merge_v(j = 1, part = "header") |>
    dhcs_theme() |>
    align(j = -1, align = "right", part = "body") |>
    bold(i = nrow(wide), part = "body")
  avail <- 9
  fw <- if (is.null(first_width)) if (length(groups) == 6) 1.6 else 2.0 else first_width
  each <- (avail - fw) / length(groups)
  ft |> width(j = 1, width = fw) |>
    width(j = seq(2, length(col_keys), 2), width = each * 0.46) |>
    width(j = seq(3, length(col_keys), 2), width = each * 0.54)
}

# Simple one-header table
dhcs_simple_table <- function(df, labels, widths, bold_last = TRUE, align_right = NULL) {
  ft <- flextable(df) |>
    set_header_labels(values = setNames(as.list(labels), names(df))) |>
    dhcs_theme()
  if (bold_last) ft <- bold(ft, i = nrow(df), part = "body")
  if (!is.null(align_right)) ft <- align(ft, j = align_right, align = "right", part = "body")
  for (j in seq_along(widths)) ft <- width(ft, j = j, width = widths[j])
  ft
}

# ---- internal tables (title above, caption below) ----------------------------------
appx_table <- function(df, caption) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  ft <- flextable(df) |> dhcs_theme(font_size = 9) |> size_to_content()
  show_table(ft, caption)
}
# Title above, table, same title as a centered caption below. Use in chunks
# with `#| output: asis`; the paragraphs also keep consecutive tables apart
# (Word merges tables that touch).
show_table <- function(ft, caption) {
  cat("\n\n::: {custom-style=\"DHCS Table Title\"}\n", caption, "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::knit_print(ft))
  cat("\n\n::: {custom-style=\"DHCS Table Caption Below\"}\n", caption, "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  invisible(NULL)
}
# Column widths from the body text (min 0.9"), capped at the 9" text width.
# Avoids flextable's "autofit" layout, which some versions write without a
# column grid (columns then collapse in Word/LibreOffice).
size_to_content <- function(ft) {
  ft <- autofit(ft, part = "body")
  w <- pmax(dim(ft)$widths, 0.9)
  ft <- width(ft, j = seq_along(w), width = w)
  if (sum(w) > 9) ft <- fit_to_width(ft, max_width = 9)
  ft
}

# ---- DHCS chart styling ---------------------------------------------------------------
chart_font <- local({
  f <- params$chart_font
  ok <- tryCatch(requireNamespace("systemfonts", quietly = TRUE) &&
                   f %in% systemfonts::system_fonts()$family, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (isTRUE(ok)) f else "sans"
})
chart_subtitle <- paste("Participants enrolled through", through_date)
text_on <- function(fill) ifelse(toupper(fill) %in% c(dhcs_blue, dhcs_teal), "white", "black")

theme_dhcs <- function(base_size = 9) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = chart_font) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = dhcs_blue, hjust = 0.5, size = base_size + 3,
                                margin = margin(b = 2)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", colour = dhcs_blue, hjust = 0.5, size = base_size + 1,
                                   margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      axis.text = element_text(colour = dhcs_blue, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = dhcs_teal, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size = unit(8, "pt"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, colour = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 14, 4, 4)
    )
}
grid_x <- theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#D9D9D9", linewidth = 0.3))

# Two charts side by side in one full-width figure (base grid; no extra packages).
# Quarto's layout-ncol assumes a portrait page in .docx and shrinks the charts.
side_by_side <- function(left, right, widths = c(1, 1)) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout = grid::grid.layout(1, 2, widths = grid::unit(widths, "null"))))
  print(left,  vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
  print(right, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 2))
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Donut of All Rounds shares
chart_donut <- function(cc, title, colours = pal4) {
  cols <- setNames(colours[seq_along(levels(cc$category))], levels(cc$category))
  df <- cc |> filter(group == "All Rounds") |>
    mutate(share = n / sum(n), fill = cols[as.character(category)],
           lab = if_else(share >= 0.05, fmt_pct(share, chart_digits), ""), txt = text_on(fill))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = 2, y = share, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = txt, group = category), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
              size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", family = chart_font) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.6, 2.5)) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = chart_subtitle) +
    theme_dhcs() +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank()) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
}

# 100% stacked horizontal bars: All Rounds + Rounds 1-5
chart_stacked <- function(cc, title, colours = pal4, xlab = "Percent of participants") {
  cols <- setNames(colours[seq_along(levels(cc$category))], levels(cc$category))
  df <- cc |>
    group_by(group) |> mutate(share = if (sum(n) > 0) n / sum(n) else 0) |> ungroup() |>
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = rev(grp_levels)), fill = cols[as.character(category)],
           lab = if_else(share >= 0.10, fmt_pct(share, chart_digits), ""), txt = text_on(fill))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = share, y = group, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = txt, group = category), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
              size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", family = chart_font) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(title = paste(title, "by Funding Round"), subtitle = chart_subtitle, x = xlab, y = NULL) +
    theme_dhcs() + grid_x +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
}

# Horizontal bars of All Rounds shares, sorted
chart_hbar <- function(df, title, fill = dhcs_blue, subtitle = chart_subtitle, wrap = 26) {
  df <- df |> arrange(desc(share)) |> mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = share, y = label)) +
    geom_col(fill = fill, width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = fmt_pct(share, chart_digits)), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold",
              colour = dhcs_blue, family = chart_font) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(wrap)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = "Percent of participants", y = NULL) +
    theme_dhcs() + grid_x
}

# One measure by group (All Rounds highlighted in DHCS Blue)
chart_by_group <- function(df, title, ylab = "Percent of participants") {
  df <- df |>
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = grp_levels),
           fill = if_else(group == "All Rounds", dhcs_blue, dhcs_teal),
           lab = if_else(is.na(share), "*", fmt_pct(share, chart_digits)))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = coalesce(share, 0), fill = fill)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lab), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", colour = dhcs_blue,
              family = chart_font) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(8)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, NA),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = chart_subtitle, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_dhcs() + theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "#7F7F7F", linewidth = 0.3))
}

# Simple columns (category on x)
chart_cols <- function(df, title, fill = dhcs_blue, ylab = "Percent of participants", pct = TRUE) {
  df <- df |> mutate(lab = if (pct) fmt_pct(value, chart_digits) else fmt_num(value, chart_digits))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = label, y = value)) +
    geom_col(fill = fill, width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lab), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", colour = dhcs_blue,
              family = chart_font) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = if (pct) percent_format(accuracy = 1) else waiver(), limits = c(0, NA),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = chart_subtitle, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_dhcs() + theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "#7F7F7F", linewidth = 0.3))
}
```

```{r}
after_period_end <- function(x) isTRUE(params$exclude_after_period_end) & !is.na(x) & x > period_end
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

This report provides an overview of participants served, outcomes and satisfaction results. Most grantees (N=`r grants_total`) are participating in the Primary Evaluation, which includes organizations delivering direct services to participants. These grantees are required to collect and submit individual-level participant data, including pre- and post-outcome measures, as part of the grant initiative's primary evaluation framework (Primary Evaluation Grants).^[In addition to grantees included in the Primary Evaluation, a subset of grantees is implementing Training and Technical Assistance (TTA), Short Duration Activities (SDA), or Mobile Crisis Services. Data from these grantees are not included in this report.] Together, these data provide an early look at grantee compliance with reporting requirements and offer preliminary insights into participant engagement, service impact, and satisfaction across the funded EBPs and CDEPs.

The focus of this report is on grantees participating in the Primary Evaluation. Specifically, it summarizes:

- Demographics and characteristics for participants enrolled through `r through_month`, overall and by funding round
- Reasons for discharge as reported by grantees
- Outcome measures results, including pre/post comparisons
- Satisfaction survey ratings, reflecting participant-reported experience of services

## Data Entry Overview

```{r}
#| label: compliance
n_entering     <- sum(entering_data)
n_not_entering <- grants_total - n_entering
n_not_serving  <- params$grantees_not_yet_serving
n_out          <- n_not_entering - n_not_serving
```

Table 1 summarizes data collection compliance among the `r grants_total` grantees participating in the primary evaluation. All grantees have now been onboarded to the eInsight data platform. Among the `r grants_total` grantees, `r n_entering` are currently entering participant records in eInsight, representing a compliance rate of `r fmt_pct(n_entering / grants_total, 0)`. Of the remaining `r n_not_entering` grantees, `r n_not_serving` (`r fmt_pct(n_not_serving / n_not_entering, 0)`) have not yet begun providing services, which accounts for their missing data. The remaining `r n_out` grantees are out of compliance and the data team, in collaboration with project partners, is working closely with these grantees to identify barriers and support their progress toward full compliance.

## Enrollments and Discharges

```{r}
#| label: episodes
# Enrollments = every record with an assigned intervention (already applied at
# load), counted per service episode, not unduplicated by client. With
# dedupe_episodes: true, rows with the same client, provider, intervention and
# start date count once (off by default; the Q2 report counted every row).
episode_keys <- c("client_system_id", "provider_id", "intervention_name", "intervention_start")
dedupe_rows  <- function(d) distinct(d, across(any_of(episode_keys)), .keep_all = TRUE)
episodes <- (if (isTRUE(params$dedupe_episodes)) dedupe_rows(discharge_data) else discharge_data) |>
  mutate(round = as_round(funding_round))
enrolled   <- episodes
# Discharges = records with an intervention end date (on or before period_end
# when exclude_after_period_end is true)
discharged <- episodes |> filter(!is.na(intervention_end), !after_period_end(intervention_end))
n_enrolled   <- nrow(enrolled)
n_discharged <- nrow(discharged)
unassigned_enrolled   <- sum(is.na(enrolled$round))
unassigned_discharged <- sum(is.na(discharged$round))
fmt_count <- function(n) if_else(n > 0 & n < threshold, "*", fmt_n(n))
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
analyst_note("Data used: discharge_data_clean.csv (DEMO records are removed when that file is built). ",
             "Enrollments = records with an assigned intervention; no start-date requirement. ",
             "Discharges = records with an intervention end date. Both count service episodes, so a client can be counted more than once. ",
             if (isTRUE(params$exclude_after_period_end)) paste0("Records that start (or, for discharges, end) after ", through_date, " are left out; records with no start date are kept. ") else "No date limits are applied. ",
             if (isTRUE(params$dedupe_episodes)) paste0("Rows with the same ", paste(intersect(episode_keys, names(discharge_data)), collapse = " + "), " are counted once (", fmt_n(nrow(discharge_data) - nrow(episodes)), " rows). ") else "Every row is counted (no de-duplication), as in the Q2 report. ",
             "The check table below shows the counts under the Q2 method, the Oct 8 draft method, and the current rule.")
```

Table 2 shows participants enrolled^[Enrollment is defined as a participant having an assigned intervention (e.g., EBP/CDEP)`r if (isTRUE(params$exclude_after_period_end)) paste0("; interventions with a start date after ", through_date, " are not included") else ""`.] in and discharged^[Discharge is defined as a participant having an end date for an assigned intervention (e.g., EBP/CDEP)`r if (isTRUE(params$exclude_after_period_end)) paste0(" on or before ", through_date) else ""`.] from an EBP/CDEP through `r through_month`. Enrollment and discharge counts represent intervention episodes rather than unique individuals. Participants who receive multiple interventions or return for additional episodes of care may appear more than once.

```{r}
#| label: enrollment-check
#| eval: !expr show_notes
#| output: asis
# Internal check: enrollment/discharge/participant counts under each counting rule
by_round <- function(d) {
  r <- as_round(d$funding_round)
  c(setNames(as.integer(table(factor(r, levels = round_levels))), round_levels),
    `Not assigned` = sum(is.na(r)), Total = nrow(d))
}
in_q2_window <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x >= period_start & x <= period_end
dedupe_any   <- function(d) distinct(d, across(any_of(episode_keys)), .keep_all = TRUE)
with_iv      <- discharge_raw |> filter(has_intervention(intervention_name))
q2_rows      <- discharge_raw |> filter(in_q2_window(intervention_start))
cap          <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x > period_end

enroll_rules <- list(
  "Enrollments: all rows in discharge_data_clean.csv" = discharge_raw,
  "Enrollments: Q2 method (start date Jan 1, 2024 to period end; every row)" = q2_rows,
  "Enrollments: Oct 8 draft (Q2 method + duplicate rows counted once)" = dedupe_any(q2_rows),
  "Enrollments: assigned intervention (every row)" = with_iv,
  "  … of which no start date" = with_iv |> filter(is.na(intervention_start)),
  "  … of which start before period start" = with_iv |> filter(!is.na(intervention_start), intervention_start < period_start),
  "  … of which start after period end" = with_iv |> filter(cap(intervention_start)),
  "  … of which duplicate client + provider + intervention + start rows" = with_iv[duplicated(with_iv[intersect(episode_keys, names(with_iv))]), ],
  "Enrollments: CURRENT SETTINGS (Table 2)" = enrolled,
  "Discharges: Q2 method (start in window, has end date; every row)" = q2_rows |> filter(!is.na(intervention_end)),
  "Discharges: Oct 8 draft (+ duplicate rows counted once)" = dedupe_any(q2_rows) |> filter(!is.na(intervention_end)),
  "Discharges: assigned intervention, has end date (every row)" = with_iv |> filter(!is.na(intervention_end)),
  "  … of which end date after period end" = with_iv |> filter(cap(intervention_end)),
  "Discharges: CURRENT SETTINGS (Table 2)" = discharged,
  "Participants (unduplicated): Q2 / Oct 8 method (start date in window)" =
    all_raw |> filter(in_q2_window(intervention_start)) |> distinct(client_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE),
  "Participants (unduplicated): CURRENT SETTINGS (demographics)" =
    all_data |> distinct(client_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
)
check_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(enroll_rules), function(nm)
  as_tibble(as.list(by_round(enroll_rules[[nm]]))) |> mutate(Rule = nm, .before = 1))) |>
  mutate(across(-Rule, fmt_n))
ft_check <- flextable(check_tbl) |>
  dhcs_theme(font_size = 8) |>
  bold(i = ~ str_detect(Rule, "CURRENT"), part = "body") |>
  align(j = -1, align = "right", part = "body") |>
  width(j = 1, width = 3.6) |> width(j = 2:8, width = 0.77)
show_table(ft_check, "Internal check: counts under each counting rule (unsuppressed; internal only)")
```

## Participant Demographics and Characteristics

This section presents an overview of the demographics and characteristics of participants who have been enrolled in an intervention through `r through_month`. Each variable includes a chart of the overall results, a chart comparing funding rounds, and a supporting data table showing results across all funding rounds (All Rounds) and for each funding round.

Percentages in each table are calculated only among participants with valid responses for that variable after excluding "Don't Know," "Prefer Not to Answer," "Not Applicable," and missing responses. Therefore, denominators differ across tables and across funding rounds. Participants are included if they have an assigned intervention, and each participant is counted once. The All Rounds column also includes participants whose records are not yet assigned to a funding round, so round-level counts will not add up exactly to the All Rounds total. Counts from 1 to `r threshold - 1` are suppressed and shown as an asterisk (\*); a category with fewer than `r threshold` participants overall is suppressed across the whole row.`r if (isTRUE(params$complementary_suppression)) " Where only one value in a column would be suppressed, the next-smallest value in that column is suppressed as well so the hidden value cannot be calculated from the total." else ""`

```{r}
#| output: asis
analyst_note("Data used: all_data (demo + discharge joined), clients with an assigned intervention", if (isTRUE(params$exclude_after_period_end)) paste0(" (interventions starting after ", through_date, " left out; no start date kept)") else "", ". Unduplicated: each table keeps one row per client_system_id (the first record with a valid response for that variable). Don't know / no selection / not applicable / prefer not to answer / blank are excluded and reported as % missing in each table's footnote (denominator = ",
             fmt_n(n_participants), " distinct participants).")
```

```{r}
#| label: demo-gender
gender <- all_data |>
  filter(!is_nonresponse(gender_identity)) |>
  mutate(category = recode_by_pattern(gender_identity, gender_rules)) |>
  make_demo(order = "freq", last = "Other")
gender_cc <- chart_counts(gender, keep = c("Woman/girl", "Man/boy"), other_label = "Another gender identity")
gender_other <- setdiff(gender$levels, c("Woman/girl", "Man/boy"))
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

#### Gender Identity

Among the `r fmt_n(gender$n_valid)` participants with a valid response, most identified as a woman/girl (`r pct_of(gender, "Woman/girl")`) or a man/boy (`r pct_of(gender, "Man/boy")`). About `r pct_of(gender, gender_other)` identified with another gender identity, including non-binary, transgender, genderqueer, and two-spirit.

```{r}
#| label: f-gender
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.9
side_by_side(
  chart_donut(gender_cc, "Gender Identity"),
  chart_stacked(gender_cc, "Gender Identity")
)
```

::: {custom-style="DHCS Data Note"}
`r source_note(ds_demo)`
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

```{r}
#| output: asis
n_small <- sum(sapply(gender_other, function(cc) { s <- share_of(gender, cc); is.na(s) || s < 0.01 }))
why_box(n_small, " of the ", length(gender$levels), " gender categories are under 1%, so they are combined into \"Another gender identity\" to keep the donut readable. The stacked bar replaces six separate pie charts, as the style guide recommends. Table 3 keeps the full detail.")
```

#### Sexual Orientation

Among the `r fmt_n(orient$n_valid)` participants with a valid response, `r pct_of(orient, "Straight")` identified as straight and `r pct_of(orient, setdiff(orient$levels, "Straight"))` identified with another sexual orientation, most often `r top_phrase(orient, 2, exclude = c("Straight", "Other"), lower = TRUE, conj = "or")`.

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
#| label: demo-age
age_rows <- ptype_rows |>
  distinct(client_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(round = as_round(funding_round),
         age = case_when(
           age_at_start_of_treatment_in_years %in% c("No Age Provided", "", " ") ~ NA_character_,
           TRUE ~ as.character(age_at_start_of_treatment_in_years)
         ) |> as.numeric() |> suppressWarnings()) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), category %in% ptype_levels)

age_long <- bind_rows(
  age_rows |> group_by(category) |> summarise(n = n(), mean_age = mean(age), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(group = "All Rounds"),
  age_rows |> filter(!is.na(round)) |> mutate(group = as.character(round)) |>
    group_by(group, category) |> summarise(n = n(), mean_age = mean(age), .groups = "drop")
) |>
  complete(group = grp_levels, category = ptype_levels, fill = list(n = 0L)) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = grp_levels), category = factor(category, levels = ptype_levels)) |>
  arrange(group, category) |>
  group_by(group) |> mutate(total = sum(n)) |> ungroup() |>
  suppress_long() |>
  mutate(mean_shown = if_else(sup, NA_real_, mean_age))

age_mean <- function(type) {
  x <- age_long |> filter(group == "All Rounds", category == type)
  if (nrow(x) == 0 || is.na(x$mean_shown)) "—" else fmt_num(x$mean_shown)
}

age_wide <- bind_rows(
  age_long |> mutate(category = as.character(category),
                     a = case_when(row_sup | n == 0 ~ "—", sup ~ "*", TRUE ~ fmt_num(mean_age)),
                     b = case_when(row_sup ~ "—", sup ~ "*", TRUE ~ fmt_n(n))),
  age_long |> distinct(group, total) |>
    mutate(category = "TOTAL", a = "N/A", b = if_else(total > 0 & total < threshold, "*", fmt_n(total)))
) |>
  mutate(key = grp_key[as.character(group)]) |>
  select(category, key, a, b) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = c(a, b), names_glue = "{key}_{.value}") |>
  mutate(.ord = match(category, c(ptype_levels, "TOTAL"))) |> arrange(.ord) |> select(-.ord)
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

#### Average Age

The average age was `r age_mean("Child (0–15)")` years for children, `r age_mean("Youth (16–25)")` years for youth, and `r age_mean("Parent/Caregiver")` years for parents/caregivers.

```{r}
#| label: f-age
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.9
age_overall <- chart_cols(age_long |> filter(group == "All Rounds") |> transmute(label = category, value = mean_shown),
           "Average Age by Participant Type", ylab = "Average age (years)", pct = FALSE)

age_cols <- setNames(c(dhcs_blue, dhcs_yellow, dhcs_teal), ptype_levels)
age_rounds <- age_long |>
  filter(group != "All Rounds") |>
  mutate(lab = if_else(is.na(mean_shown), "*", fmt_num(mean_shown, chart_digits))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = coalesce(mean_shown, 0), fill = category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab), position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.4, size = 2.3,
            fontface = "bold", colour = dhcs_blue, family = chart_font) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = age_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(title = "Average Age by Type and Round", subtitle = chart_subtitle, x = NULL, y = "Average age (years)") +
  theme_dhcs() + theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "#7F7F7F", linewidth = 0.3))
side_by_side(age_overall, age_rounds)
```

::: {custom-style="DHCS Data Note"}
`r source_note(ds_demo)`
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

```{r}

why_box("Average age compares values rather than parts of a whole, so column charts are used and pie charts are not. The vertical axis starts at zero to avoid exaggerating differences.")
```

```{r}
  mutate(reason = recode_by_pattern(reason_for_discharge, discharge_rules, other = "Other"))
lv13 <- c("Successful Completion", "Withdrew from/refused treatment",
          "No contact within 90 days of last encounter", "Clinically referred out")

# 13a: all discharges with a reason; "No Reason Selected" excluded; Other + Death combined
d13a <- disc |>
  filter(!is.na(reason), reason != "No Reason Selected") |>
  mutate(category = if_else(reason %in% c("Other", "Death"), "Other/Death", reason))
long13a <- count_long(d13a, c(lv13, "Other/Death")) |> suppress_long() |> filter(group == "All Rounds")
t13a <- bind_rows(
  long13a |> transmute(category = as.character(category),
                       pct = if_else(sup, "*", fmt_pct(n / total)), n = if_else(sup, "*", fmt_n(n))),
  tibble(category = "TOTAL", pct = "100.0%", n = fmt_n(long13a$total[1]))
)

# 13b: every discharge, by round; Other = Other + Death + No Reason Selected + blank
d13b <- disc |>
  mutate(category = if_else(is.na(reason) | reason %in% c("Other", "Death", "No Reason Selected"), "Other", reason))
res13b <- list(long = count_long(d13b, c(lv13, "Other")) |> suppress_long(),
               levels = c(lv13, "Other"), small_rows = "dash")
```

```{r}
#| label: outcomes-compute
outcome_levels <- c("worsened", "no_change", "improved")

score_stats <- function(long) {
  long |>
    filter(!is.na(score_value)) |>
    group_by(score_type) |>
    summarise(mean = round(mean(score_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
              median = median(score_value, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd = round(sd(score_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
              n = sum(!is.na(score_value)), .groups = "drop")
}
to_long <- function(df, initial, follow_up) {
  df |>
    select(client_system_id, all_of(c(initial, follow_up))) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(c(initial, follow_up)), names_to = "score_type", values_to = "score_value") |>
    mutate(score_type = factor(if_else(score_type == initial, "Initial", "Follow-up"),
                               levels = c("Initial", "Follow-up")))
}

# 3.03 / 3.04 — NOMS Q1, single item, range 1–5 (same logic as the Q2 report)
noms_single <- function(pairs, q) {
  data <- pairs |> filter(question == q)
  scored <- data |>
    mutate(
      positive_outcome = case_when(
        is.na(follow_up_score) | is.na(initial_score) ~ NA_character_,
        follow_up_score > initial_score ~ "improved",
        follow_up_score < initial_score ~ "worsened",
        TRUE ~ "no_change"
      ),
      positive_outcome = factor(positive_outcome, levels = outcome_levels)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(positive_outcome))
  long <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(client_system_id), !is.na(initial_score), !is.na(follow_up_score)) |>
    to_long("initial_score", "follow_up_score")
  list(outcome = scored$positive_outcome,
       tabyl = scored |> tabyl(positive_outcome) |> adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 0),
       stats = score_stats(long),
       pct = data |>
         summarise(initial_4_5  = round(100 * mean(initial_score[!is.na(initial_score)]     %in% c(4, 5)), 2),
                   followup_4_5 = round(100 * mean(follow_up_score[!is.na(follow_up_score)] %in% c(4, 5)), 2)))
}

# 3.05–3.10 — NOMS Q2–Q4 subscales, summed items (same logic as the Q2 report)
noms_subscale <- function(pairs, prefix, lo, hi, cutoff) {
  diff <- pairs |>
    filter(str_detect(question, paste0("^", prefix, ".*_score$")),
           !is.na(initial_score), !is.na(follow_up_score), !is.na(client_system_id)) |>
    group_by(client_system_id) |>
    summarise(initial_total  = sum(initial_score, na.rm = TRUE),
              followup_total = sum(follow_up_score, na.rm = TRUE),
              positive_outcome = case_when(
                followup_total > initial_total ~ "improved",
                followup_total < initial_total ~ "worsened",
                TRUE ~ "no_change"
              ),
              positive_outcome = factor(positive_outcome, levels = outcome_levels),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    distinct(client_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    filter(between(initial_total, lo, hi), between(followup_total, lo, hi))
  list(outcome = diff$positive_outcome,
       tabyl = diff |> filter(!is.na(positive_outcome)) |> tabyl(positive_outcome) |> adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 0),
       stats = score_stats(to_long(diff, "initial_total", "followup_total")),
       pct = diff |>
         summarise(!!paste0("initial_", cutoff)  := round(100 * mean(initial_total >= cutoff), 2),
                   !!paste0("followup_", cutoff) := round(100 * mean(followup_total >= cutoff), 2)))
}

q303 <- noms_single(pairs_primary_long_child, "q1_how_would_you_rate_your_child_s_overall_mental_health_right_now_score")
q304 <- noms_single(pairs_primary_long_self,  "q1_how_would_you_rate_your_overall_mental_health_right_now_score")
q305 <- noms_subscale(pairs_primary_long_child, "x2", 7, 35, 28)
q306 <- noms_subscale(pairs_primary_long_self,  "x2", 7, 35, 28)
q307 <- noms_subscale(pairs_primary_long_child, "x3", 7, 35, 28)
q308 <- noms_subscale(pairs_primary_long_self,  "x3", 7, 35, 28)
q309 <- noms_subscale(pairs_primary_long_child, "x4", 6, 30, 24)
q310 <- noms_subscale(pairs_primary_long_self,  "x4", 6, 30, 24)

# 3.12 PSS and 3.15 CPSS-5 (positive_outcome comes precomputed in the paired files)
paired_summary <- function(paired) {
  list(tabyl = paired |> filter(!is.na(positive_outcome)) |> tabyl(positive_outcome) |> adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 0),
       stats = paired |>
         filter(!is.na(client_system_id), !is.na(initial_score), !is.na(follow_up_score)) |>
         to_long("initial_score", "follow_up_score") |> score_stats(),
       paired = paired)
}
q312  <- paired_summary(pss_paired)
q315i <- paired_summary(cpss_i_paired)
q315s <- paired_summary(cpss_s_paired)

# positive_outcome may be text ("improved"/"positive"/"yes"), logical, or 0/1
is_positive <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x == 1)
  x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  if_else(is.na(x), NA, str_detect(x, "^(improv|positiv|yes|true|1$)"))
}

outcome_row <- function(domain, reporter, outcome) {
  outcome <- outcome[!is.na(outcome)]
  n <- length(outcome)
  p <- function(l) if (n == 0) "—" else if (n < threshold) "*" else fmt_pct(mean(outcome == l), 0)
  tibble(domain = domain, reporter = reporter,
         n = if (n == 0) "—" else if (n < threshold) "*" else fmt_n(n),
         worsened = p("worsened"), no_change = p("no_change"), improved = p("improved"))
}
t14 <- bind_rows(
  outcome_row("Mental health",          "Caregiver-rated youth", q303$outcome),
  outcome_row("Mental health",          "Self-report",           q304$outcome),
  outcome_row("Daily life functioning", "Caregiver-rated youth", q305$outcome),
  outcome_row("Daily life functioning", "Self-report",           q306$outcome),
  outcome_row("General well-being",     "Caregiver-rated youth", q307$outcome),
  outcome_row("General well-being",     "Self-report",           q308$outcome),
  outcome_row("Social connectedness",   "Caregiver-rated youth", q309$outcome),
  outcome_row("Social connectedness",   "Self-report",           q310$outcome)
)

paired_row <- function(measure, reporter, res, range) {
  ini <- res$stats |> filter(score_type == "Initial")
  fu  <- res$stats |> filter(score_type == "Follow-up")
  n   <- if (nrow(ini) == 0) 0 else ini$n
  pos <- is_positive(res$paired$positive_outcome)
  pos <- pos[!is.na(pos)]
  small <- n < threshold
  chg <- function(a, b) paste0(fmt_num(a), " → ", fmt_num(b), "\nRange: ", range)
  tibble(measure = measure, reporter = reporter,
         n = if (n == 0) "—" else if (small) "*" else fmt_n(n),
         direction = "Lower = better",
         mean   = if (small) "*" else chg(ini$mean, fu$mean),
         median = if (small) "*" else chg(ini$median, fu$median),
         pos    = if (small || length(pos) == 0) "*" else fmt_pct(mean(pos), 0))
}
t15 <- bind_rows(
  paired_row("Child/Youth PTSD Symptoms/Severity (CPSS-5)", "Interviewer-rated youth aged 8–18", q315i, "0–80"),
  paired_row("Child/Youth PTSD Symptoms/Severity (CPSS-5)", "Self-report youth aged 8–18",       q315s, "0–80")
)
t16 <- paired_row("Parent-related stress (PSS)", "Self-report caregiver/parent aged 18 or older", q312, "18–90")
paired_labels <- c("Domain and Measure details", "Reporter", "Paired N (Initial/ Most Recent Follow-up)",
                   "Direction", "Mean (Initial → Most Recent Follow-up)",
                   "Median (Initial → Most Recent Follow-up)",
                   "% with a positive outcome from Initial to Most Recent Follow-up")
paired_widths <- c(1.6, 1.5, 1.0, 0.9, 1.35, 1.35, 1.3)
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Participant Outcomes (Pre and Post Measures)

This section summarizes within-participant changes in clinical and functional outcomes from the initial assessment to the most recent follow-up among participants with outcomes data available at both time points (paired assessments). To improve readability, results are organized by outcome domain (functional outcomes, symptom/stress outcomes, and assessing equitable impact: exploratory subgroup analyses) rather than by individual evaluation questions.

Because paired sample sizes vary by measure and because outcome tools differ in scale and distribution, results are presented using the highest feasible level of evidence for each measure:

- **Tier 1 (Descriptive paired change):** Paired pre/post descriptive change (e.g., mean/median change and distribution summaries) when sample sizes are smaller and/or tests are not appropriate.
- **Tier 2 (Distribution shifts/categorical outcomes):** Paired shifts in response distributions or percent meeting a "positive outcome" definition; interpret as preliminary unless a paired test is explicitly noted.

These interim findings provide early evidence on outcome trajectories among participants served, but they do not yet establish whether observed changes can be attributed to the Workstream, nor do they fully answer all the evaluation study questions focused on Workstream impact. Assessing "impact" requires additional analytic steps, including stronger baseline/contextual comparisons, adjustment for differences in participant characteristics and service exposure, and (where feasible) comparison to appropriate reference groups or historical trends.

::: {custom-style="DHCS Caution"}
**Interpretation cautions.**

• NOMS subscales do not have established clinical cutoffs or a reliable change index; improvements are summarized using mean/median shifts and the share rating 4–5.

• Not all grantees administer the same tools, and not all participants have both initial and discharge assessments; results reflect the subset with available data.

• Some measures are reported with more than one "positive outcome" definition (e.g., YOQ results with/without a reliable change requirement); interpret comparisons accordingly.

• Exploratory subgroup models are descriptive and may be affected by missing data and measurement differences across programs.
:::

Paired to the last follow-up. NAs excluded before computing percentages. NOMS Q2–Q4 subscales are sums of items, kept only when both totals fall inside the valid range (7–35 or 6–30). The per-question detail tables (summary statistics, % scoring 4–5 / at or above the cutoff) and the SDQ results are in the analyst appendix.")

```{r}
#| label: setup-outcomes
# "Including no change" outcome rules (from the Q2 report); used for the
# met-treatment-goals RBA and the appendix.
assessment_rules <- tibble::tribble(
  ~trimmed_pre_assessment_name, ~higher_is_better, ~min_change,
  "Basis-24",  FALSE, 0.001, # weighted 0–4 scale; any positive change counts
  "CATS",      FALSE, 1,
  "GAD-7",     FALSE, 1,
  "NOMS",      TRUE,  1,
  "Pediatric", FALSE, 1,
  "PHQ-9",     FALSE, 1,
  "PSS",       FALSE, 1,
  "SDQ",       FALSE, 1,
  "YOQ",       FALSE, 10
)

discharge_outcome <- discharge_data |>
  left_join(assessment_rules, by = "trimmed_pre_assessment_name") |>
  mutate(
    raw_change    = post_score - pre_score,
    better_change = if_else(higher_is_better, raw_change, -raw_change),
    min_change    = coalesce(min_change, 0),
    outcome = case_when(
      is.na(pre_score) | is.na(post_score) ~ NA_character_,
      better_change >=  min_change ~ "improved",
      better_change <= -min_change ~ "worsened",
      TRUE                         ~ "no_change"
    ),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("worsened", "no_change", "improved"))
  )

# Met treatment goals: Successful Completion AND a simple pre/post improvement
# in the tool's positive direction (footnote definition). Rows need a discharge
# reason (not "No Reason Selected") and a tool with a known direction.
goals_base <- discharge_outcome |>
  mutate(reason = recode_by_pattern(reason_for_discharge, discharge_rules, other = "Other")) |>
  filter(!is.na(better_change), !is.na(reason), reason != "No Reason Selected")
pct_met <- mean(goals_base$reason == "Successful Completion" & goals_base$better_change > 0)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-satisfaction
sat_all <- read_csv(params$satisfaction_data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Unified Q1 score — coalesce across three survey-specific Q1 columns
sat_all <- sat_all |>
  mutate(
    q1_score = coalesce(
      x1_overall_i_am_satisfied_with_the_services_my_child_received_score,
      x1_overall_i_am_satisfied_with_the_services_i_received_score,
      x1_i_like_the_services_that_i_received_here_score
    )
  )

all_data_distinct <- all_data |>
  distinct(client_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    provider_system_id = as.character(provider_system_id),
    client_system_id   = as.character(client_system_id)
  )

sat_all_data <- sat_all |>
  mutate(
    provider_system_id = as.character(provider_system_id),
    client_system_id   = as.character(client_system_id)
  ) |>
  left_join(all_data_distinct,
            by = c("provider", "provider_id", "provider_system_id", "client_system_id")) |>
  filter(!is.na(intervention_name))

# Survey item columns only (taken from the survey file, so score columns that
# arrive with the join aren't counted; q1_score is a copy of an x1 column)
score_cols <- setdiff(names(sat_all)[str_detect(names(sat_all), "_score$")], "q1_score")

sat_round <- sat_all_data |> mutate(round = as_round(funding_round))
sat_by_round <- sat_round |>
  filter(!is.na(round)) |>
  group_by(round) |>
  summarise(n_surveys = n(), n_q1 = sum(!is.na(q1_score)), n_high = sum(q1_score %in% c(4, 5)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(round, fill = list(n_surveys = 0L, n_q1 = 0L, n_high = 0L))
n_surveys        <- sum(sat_by_round$n_surveys)
pct_q1           <- sum(sat_by_round$n_high) / sum(sat_by_round$n_q1)
n_sat_unassigned <- sum(is.na(sat_round$round))

pref_col <- "were_written_documents_and_or_the_services_you_received_provided_in_the_language_you_prefer_response"
sat_assigned <- sat_round |> filter(!is.na(round))
pref_yes <- if (pref_col %in% names(sat_assigned)) {
  str_detect(sat_assigned[[pref_col]], regex("^\\s*yes", ignore_case = TRUE))
} else rep(NA, nrow(sat_assigned))
pct_pref          <- sum(pref_yes, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(sat_assigned)   # definition: out of all surveys
pct_pref_answered <- mean(pref_yes, na.rm = TRUE)                       # alternative: out of those who answered
```

```{r}
#| label: appendix-setup

# Q2 suppression helpers, kept for the appendix tables -------------------------------
suppress_labeled_counts <- function(labels, counts, threshold = 11, total_label = "Total") {
  is_total <- labels == total_label
  is_small <- !is.na(counts) & counts < threshold & !is_total
  any_small <- any(is_small)
  out <- ifelse(!is.na(counts) & counts < threshold,
                paste0("<", threshold), format(counts, big.mark = ","))
  if (any_small) out[is_total] <- paste0("<", threshold)
  list(display = out, suppressed = is_small | (any_small & is_total))
}
apply_suppression <- function(tabyl_df, label_col = 1, n_col = "n", pct_col = "percent") {
  labels <- tabyl_df[[label_col]]
  counts <- tabyl_df[[n_col]]
  sup <- suppress_labeled_counts(labels, counts, threshold = threshold)
  tabyl_df[[n_col]] <- sup$display
  tabyl_df[[pct_col]] <- ifelse(sup$suppressed, "suppressed", tabyl_df[[pct_col]])
  tabyl_df
}
dhcs_crosstab <- function(data, row_var, col_var, threshold = 11) {
  row_var <- rlang::ensym(row_var)
  col_var <- rlang::ensym(col_var)
  counts <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(!!row_var), !is.na(!!col_var)) |>
    count(!!row_var, !!col_var, name = "n") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = !!col_var, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
  group_cols <- setdiff(names(counts), rlang::as_string(row_var))
  totals <- counts |>
    summarise(across(all_of(group_cols), sum)) |>
    mutate(!!row_var := "Total")
  full <- bind_rows(counts |> mutate(!!row_var := as.character(!!row_var)), totals)
  col_totals <- full[full[[rlang::as_string(row_var)]] == "Total", group_cols] |> unlist()
  out <- full
  for (col in group_cols) {
    raw <- full[[col]]
    labels <- full[[rlang::as_string(row_var)]]
    sup <- suppress_labeled_counts(labels, raw, threshold = threshold)
    pct <- percent(raw / col_totals[[col]], accuracy = 1)
    out[[col]] <- ifelse(sup$suppressed, paste0("<", threshold),
                         paste0(format(raw, big.mark = ","), " (", pct, ")"))
  }
  out
}
```

```{r}
#| label: appendix-crosswalk
#| eval: !expr show_notes
#| output: asis
xwalk <- function(variable, raw, fun, flag_nonresponse = TRUE) {
  tibble(raw = as.character(raw)) |>
    count(raw, name = "n") |>
    mutate(variable = variable,
           label = if (flag_nonresponse) if_else(is_nonresponse(raw), "(excluded: non-response)", fun(raw)) else fun(raw),
           label = coalesce(label, "(blank)"), raw = coalesce(raw, "(blank)")) |>
    select(variable, raw, label, n)
}
crosswalk <- bind_rows(
  xwalk("Gender identity", all_data$gender_identity, function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, gender_rules)),
  xwalk("Sexual orientation", all_data$sexual_orientation, function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, orientation_rules)),
  xwalk("Primary language", all_data$primary_language, function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, language_rules)),
  xwalk("Insurance status", all_data$insurance_status, function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, insurance_rules, other = "Other")),
  xwalk("Housing status", all_data$housing_status, function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, housing_rules, other = house_levels[3])),
  xwalk("Participant type", all_data$client_type, function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, client_type_rules)),
  xwalk("Caregiver education", all_data$highest_caregiver_education_level, function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, education_rules)),
  xwalk("Discharge reason", discharged$reason_for_discharge,
        function(x) recode_by_pattern(x, discharge_rules, other = "Other"), flag_nonresponse = FALSE)
) |>
  mutate(n = fmt_n(n))
dhcs_simple_table(crosswalk, c("Variable", "Raw eInsight value", "Report label", "n (unsuppressed)"),
                  widths = c(1.7, 3.4, 2.6, 1.3), bold_last = FALSE) |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
  align(j = 4, align = "right", part = "body") |>
  show_table("Category crosswalk – raw eInsight values and report labels (unsuppressed; internal only)")
```

```{r}
sat_items <- sat_round |>
  select(round, all_of(score_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(score_cols), ~ na_if(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)), 0)))
m <- as.matrix(sat_items[score_cols])
sat_items <- sat_items |>
  mutate(n_answered = rowSums(!is.na(m)),
         n_agree    = rowSums(m == 4 | m == 5, na.rm = TRUE),
         pct_agree  = n_agree / n_answered)
combined_overall <- sat_items |>
  summarise(n_total = n(), n_meeting_80pct = sum(pct_agree >= 0.8, na.rm = TRUE),
            pct_meeting_80pct = round(100 * n_meeting_80pct / n_total, 1))
combined_by_round <- sat_items |>
  filter(!is.na(round)) |>
  group_by(round) |>
  summarise(n_total = n(), n_meeting_80pct = sum(pct_agree >= 0.8, na.rm = TRUE),
            pct_meeting_80pct = round(100 * n_meeting_80pct / n_total, 1), .groups = "drop")

appx_table(combined_overall, "Combined survey high satisfaction (>=80% of answered items agree/strongly agree), overall")
appx_table(combined_by_round, "Combined survey high satisfaction, by funding round")
if (pref_col %in% names(sat_round)) {
  appx_table(sat_round |> rename(preferred_lang_response = all_of(pref_col)) |>
               tabyl(preferred_lang_response) |> adorn_totals("row") |>
               adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 1) |> apply_suppression(),
             "Services received in preferred language (all responses)")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: appendix-sdq
#| eval: !expr show_notes
#| output: asis
# 3.11 / 3.16 SDQ — a decrease in score indicates a positive outcome (Q2 code)
analyze_sdq <- function(paired) {
  tab_total <- paired |>
    filter(!is.na(positive_outcome_total)) |>
    tabyl(positive_outcome_total) |>
    adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 0)
  tab_ext <- paired |>
    filter(!is.na(positive_outcome_ext)) |>
    tabyl(positive_outcome_ext) |>
    adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 0)
  list(summary_total = tab_total, summary_ext = tab_ext)
}
sdq_subgroup_levels <- c("SDQ Parent (2-4)", "SDQ Parent (4-10)", "SDQ Parent (11-17)", "SDQ Self (11-17)")
res_P24   <- analyze_sdq(sdq_P24_pairs)
res_P410  <- analyze_sdq(sdq_P410_pairs)
res_P1117 <- analyze_sdq(sdq_P1117_pairs)
res_S1117 <- analyze_sdq(sdq_S1117_pairs)

df_from_lists <- bind_rows(
  sdq_P24_pairs   |> transmute(subgroup = "SDQ Parent (2-4)",   initial_total, follow_up_total, initial_ext, follow_up_ext),
  sdq_P410_pairs  |> transmute(subgroup = "SDQ Parent (4-10)",  initial_total, follow_up_total, initial_ext, follow_up_ext),
  sdq_P1117_pairs |> transmute(subgroup = "SDQ Parent (11-17)", initial_total, follow_up_total, initial_ext, follow_up_ext),
  sdq_S1117_pairs |> transmute(subgroup = "SDQ Self (11-17)",   initial_total, follow_up_total, initial_ext, follow_up_ext)
)
sdq_stats <- function(init, fu) {
  df_from_lists |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[init]]), !is.na(.data[[fu]])) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(c(init, fu)), names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(subgroup  = factor(subgroup, levels = sdq_subgroup_levels),
           timepoint = if_else(timepoint == init, "Initial", "Follow-up")) |>
    group_by(subgroup, timepoint) |>
    summarise(mean = round(mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
              median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd = round(sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
              n = sum(!is.na(value)), .groups = "drop")
}

appx_table(res_P24$summary_total,   "3.16 SDQ Parent (2–4) — % with positive outcome, total score")
appx_table(res_P24$summary_ext,     "3.11 SDQ Parent (2–4) — % with positive outcome, externalizing score")
appx_table(res_P410$summary_total,  "3.16 SDQ Parent (4–10) — % with positive outcome, total score")
appx_table(res_P410$summary_ext,    "3.11 SDQ Parent (4–10) — % with positive outcome, externalizing score")
appx_table(res_P1117$summary_total, "3.16 SDQ Parent (11–17) — % with positive outcome, total score")
appx_table(res_P1117$summary_ext,   "3.11 SDQ Parent (11–17) — % with positive outcome, externalizing score")
appx_table(res_S1117$summary_total, "3.16 SDQ Self (11–17) — % with positive outcome, total score")
appx_table(res_S1117$summary_ext,   "3.11 SDQ Self (11–17) — % with positive outcome, externalizing score")
appx_table(sdq_stats("initial_total", "follow_up_total"), "3.16 SDQ — Summary statistics, total difficulties score")
appx_table(sdq_stats("initial_ext", "follow_up_ext"),     "3.11 SDQ — Summary statistics, externalizing score")
```
